title: [Bug] Spec-v2 workers diverge on forward_batch_generation signature — 4 of 7 missing pp_proxy_tensors the scheduler always passes
body:
### Describe the bug

The scheduler's non-overlap speculative path always passes `pp_proxy_tensors` to the spec worker:

- `srt/managers/scheduler.py:4514` and `:4527` — `self.model_worker.forward_batch_generation(batch, pp_proxy_tensors=pp_proxy_tensors)`

But the spec-v2 workers have diverged on this signature. Audit of `python/sglang/srt/speculative/` on current `main`:

| Worker | `pp_proxy_tensors` |
|---|---|
| `eagle_worker_v2.py` | ✅ has it |
| `dflash_worker_v2.py` | ✅ has it |
| `ngram_worker.py` | ✅ has it |
| `dspark_components/dspark_worker_v2.py` | ❌ missing — reported in #39262 |
| `multi_layer_eagle_worker_v2.py` | ❌ missing — fixed inline in PR #29189 |
| `frozen_kv_mtp_worker_v2.py` | ❌ missing — unreported |
| `uno_worker_v2.py` | ❌ missing — unreported |

Any model served through one of the four ❌ workers dies on the first scheduler step that takes this path with:

```
TypeError: <Worker>.forward_batch_generation() got an unexpected keyword argument 'pp_proxy_tensors'
```

Root cause: `BaseSpecWorker` (`srt/speculative/base_spec_worker.py:154`) is an ABC but never declares `forward_batch_generation`, so nothing enforces the interface the scheduler calls through. Each worker evolved its own signature and three of them silently fell behind.

### Reproduction

See #39262 for a concrete DSpark repro (any configuration that forces the non-overlap path hits it on the first step). The same applies to the other three workers.

### Expected behavior / proposed fix

1. Add `pp_proxy_tensors=None` (and pass it through to the target worker) to `dspark_worker_v2.py`, `frozen_kv_mtp_worker_v2.py`, and `uno_worker_v2.py` — same one-line shape as the `multi_layer_eagle_worker_v2.py` fix in #29189.
2. Declare `forward_batch_generation` on `BaseSpecWorker` (abstract method or a shared `Protocol`) so the next divergence fails at import/lint time instead of at the first request.

### Related

- #39262 — the DSpark instance of this bug
- #29189 — carries the `multi_layer_eagle_worker_v2.py` hunk as part of GigaChat 3.5 support
- #39885 — PP multi-layer EAGLE worker (separate `MultiLayerEagleWorkerPP` class); worth aligning on which component owns PP for multi-layer EAGLE before both land
